scope: Same-GSI slow-path resume. Not a family admission.

requestHosts.reading: Each host symbol is in this GSI and each name is a procedure. The return descriptors are the configured label-table entries in the linked _thread.c. Those descriptor words are not unique in the image, so the bind is the host symbol, not the immediate alone.

join.reading: A zero timeout returns the timeout value while the child is blocked. The later join returns the child result. Joining that settled thread again returns the same result, and joining an already finished thread returns its result instead of the timeout value.

resume.reading: The fast grant was forced to fail once. The handler then collected, reloaded the argument slots, claimed READY once, and entered the body once. The rest element stayed eq? to the token allocated before the call.
